mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 110, it signals strong supply that may outpace demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 110 but S&P 500 returns remain positive.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment combined with high payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 4% and PAYEMS growth but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in federal funds rate signals easing monetary policy, boosting equity markets with positive returns in 5 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS drop but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts and retail sales indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS growth but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment below 4% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 4% but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 2% combined with GDP growth signals strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO and GDPC1 growth but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate and high CPI indicate inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL but S&P 500 returns are positive.
